experiment.reference_scope: FP64 coupled three-level RK4 on the same semidiscrete grid; full final refinement difference
experiment.timing_scope: One sequential sample of complete uncached CPU method steps; rollout sums all method calls; excludes reference/report costs
experiment.work_scope: Actual successful-call counters accumulated across steps; split charges each active FFT pair and exact reaction; validation is timed; failed-call partial counters are unavailable when work_counts_complete is false

limitations: Quadratic correction is a finite-amplitude truncation, not a whole-solver order upgrade.
Same-grid references do not certify continuum accuracy.
Single uncached CPU timing samples do not establish cost-to-tolerance superiority.
No scientific gate, automatic training or GPU successor is authorized by completion.
